origin: A specification review makes two kinds of call and they land in different documents. Where a source states the answer or the record determines it, the call is the record's and the specification is the only thing that changes. Where the record leaves a fork open and first principles over the decisions it made whittle it to one answer the session stands behind, the call is the session's — a decision the owning source document never took — so it lands there first, carrying what leaned and the alternatives that also fit, and the specification re-aligns to it. This walks both through the settled batch: a first screen while the gate is on, where the user hands the rest over, and a second under auto, where the screen documents what landed and never stops. The second screen holds the two derivations side by side, so the landing has to discriminate rather than blanket-apply.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments specification to run its review; construction finished last sitting, so offered the resume choice they continue. They know the discussion cold and treat what it determines as decided, not theirs to re-litigate. The first thing the review puts to them is a one-row screen of calls made on their behalf, each with what it rests on named beside it, offering to document the screen, to hand every remaining call over automatically, to pull one out and talk about it, or to expand one. They hand the rest over automatically and say why: they do not want to be stopped again for things the record has already decided. After that they are content for the review to document what it finds and tell them what it did, and they ask for nothing to be expanded. On an order the gateway never confirms they are clear whenever it comes up: they would not have the checkout cancel an order it cannot show failed, and they are content for a customer to be told the payment is still confirming. The follow-up review cycle runs without asking them and comes back clean, and the session moves to completion on its own; at sign-off they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely and never reopen decided questions.
